prerequisite: The drawing has a layer of closed boundary polylines (e.g. 01-CHANNEL) and an existing-ground TIN surface
fixture_requirements: >= 2 closed polylines on the boundary layer, at least one with an arc segment
At least one boundary with a text object inside (verifies automatic region naming)
At least one boundary entirely inside the existing-ground surface (verifies off_surface_points == 0)
An open polyline on the same layer (verifies only closed ones are collected)
assertions: Read-only node: no Commit; drawing dbmod and file size are unchanged after the run
regions == number of closed polylines on the boundary layer; open ones are not counted
with boundaries given as a handle whitelist only those are surveyed; when none matches, throw and name boundary_layer
area/perimeter match LIST on that polyline in CAD (arcs by true arc length, not chord)
winding is judged by signed area, not Polyline.Area (Area is always positive and cannot tell the direction)
labels are the texts falling inside the boundary; with label_layer empty, texts on C3DF-* layers (grid elevation annotations etc.) are excluded from labels
id is the first text inside the region; without any text it falls back to R01/R02 numbering
with neither surface nor start_elev given, only the geometry columns are output and warnings say so; no throw
a surface name absent from the drawing throws and names it
with start_elev given, z_top_min == z_top_max == start_elev (fixed around the whole ring)
with start_elev_cap given, z_top_max <= cap
samples whose crest elevation is below bottom_elev are raised to bottom_elev (band = 0 there, no grading)
without bottom_elev the est_* columns are absent (survey only, no trial)
est_cut_volume is of the same order as the downstream create_dredge_grading + calculate_surface_volume TIN result (default 5 m grid, deviation within 5%)
halving grid_step changes est_cut_volume by < 2% (convergence)
increasing slope_ratio_m increases est_cut_volume monotonically (flatter slope, more cut)
grid points outside the existing-ground surface count toward est_off_surface_cells and are named in warnings, never silently treated as 0
slope_ratio_m <= 0 throws
sample_step <= 0 / grid_step <= 0 throws
with export_excel=true a parameter-table skeleton is written, last row is the total, excel_files is non-empty
two runs with the same parameters give byte-identical results (read-only idempotence)
